source.note: Kenney train-locomotive-b (the plan row named train-locomotive-a; the kit has three steam locomotives, a, b and c, and b reads best as a classic steam engine at a glance: tall chimney, steam and sand domes, open cab, big spoked drivers with coupling rods; a is a green side-tank engine, c a long blue tender-style engine whose colour map flattens noisily). FBX member plus its colormap texture, flattened to 20 colours, as train-bullet. Scaled with the same factor as train-bullet, train-commuter and train-tram (kit units x 2.26), so it couples with them at the same size: 3.75 m from rail to cab roof (a real small tank engine is ~3.8-4.0 m). Stylized proportions as the other Kenney trains: 5.88 m long and 2.97 m wide. Red boiler with navy panels, cab and underframe, white wheels, in the red-and-navy of train-commuter. The wheels are separate nodes (wheel, wheel_1..3 the drivers, wheels-front the leading truck), so they can be spun in code. Static, no clips.
